brief: @buildthis.bisks.net skifree clone but update graphics and make it super neuromancer themed and cyberpunk. Remember to give it mobile friendly controls. The monster at the end is a grotesque and monstrous cyborg crow
note: SkiFree, jacked into the matrix: neon slope-grid, corrupted-block rocks, data-spire trees, chips to lift — and a cyborg crow that wakes up and hunts you down. Drag to steer on mobile.
